rows.title: Department of War anchor investment in the Missile Solutions (MSL) business: $1.0B convertible preferred security
rows.detail: On January 13, 2026 L3Harris announced a strategic investment by the DoW in its MSL business: the DoW agreed to be the anchor investor through a $1.0 billion convertible preferred security, anticipated to convert automatically into common equity upon the completion of an IPO of the MSL business (10-K, filed 02-12-2026).
